title: fix(objectql): temporal-comparand and text-operator filter refusals state the prescription inside the client message cap
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgKURKuRGF1ewEVVZKx7U1i4)_

Fixes #27173

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：查询过滤里写了日期字段读不懂的值（如 `"last_30_days"`、年份超范围、不存在的日子、非 ISO 写法、解析后超范围的相对日期占位符），或对数字/布尔等字段用了文本操作符（`$contains` 等）时，`400 INVALID_FILTER` 报错现在先说"错在哪"，紧接着说"该怎么写"，最后才讲"没执行"和后果。只动了 objectql 里这两处报错的句子顺序和措辞。
- **为什么改**：客户端只读得到报错前 500 个字符。原文案把"该怎么写"放在最后，测得 306 个样例里 172 个连补救句的开头都被截掉，281 个补救不完整；开发者（或 AI）只知道错了，不知道改成什么。
- **风险与回滚**：低。500 字符上限、截断方式、错误码与状态码都没变，被拒绝的过滤集合也没变；只是同一条报错里句子换了顺序，`datetime` 的补救句改为先给相对日期占位符、年份范围补救句缩短。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/objectql/src/temporal-comparand-door.ts`（六处 throw 与 `REMEDY` / `YEAR_CLASS`）；`packages/objectql/src/text-operator-declared-type-door.ts`（一处 throw）；`packages/objectql/src/filter-refusal-prescription-cap.test.ts`（新 pin）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/filter-refusal-prescription-cap.test.ts`，预期 31/31 通过；把这两个 producer 换回 `main` 版本再跑，31 条全部失败。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Two `INVALID_FILTER` / 400 producers on `where`, `aggregations[i].filter` and `having` printed their prescription last, after the consequence and "NOT applied". A client reads at most 500 characters (`CLIENT_MESSAGE_MAX` in `@objectstack/types`, cut with an ellipsis), so the prescription was often cut. Each refusal is now ordered: the verdict (what was written, where, and why it is not a value of its kind), then the prescription, then "NOT applied" and the consequence. The cap, the truncation, the code, the status and the set of refused filters are unchanged, as the triage ruled (6465970858): "⛔ The same rule as #27098: the prescription goes first, at the producer, and the cap and envelope stay unchanged."

- **`temporal-comparand-door.ts`**: all six throw sites (junk, year class, misread class on `where` and `having`; the resolved-placeholder refusal on both) move the remedy ahead of "NOT applied". The verdict clause shortens to "so it is not a KIND value" on the year and misread arms (the junk arm keeps "which is not a KIND value this platform can interpret"), and the placeholder arms drop the repeated "the years a KIND value may name". `REMEDY.datetime` now names the relative-date placeholder first, as its own doc comment always said it did, and is shorter; the two year-class remedies are shorter. A module section, "Prescription first, inside the client cap", records the rule.
- **`text-operator-declared-type-door.ts`**: "Compare FIELD with an operator its declared type can answer …" now follows "A TYPE value is never a string on any backend." The no-match-rule explanation moves after "NOT applied".
- **`engine-aggregate-having-temporal-door.test.ts`**: the case that read the remedy after "NOT applied" now reads it between the verdict and "NOT applied", on both `having` and its `where` twin, and still requires them equal.

### Measured: remedy position in the message (306 messages, matrix below)

Matrix: three name sizes (object/field 1/1, 12/12, 25/31 characters) × every refusal class × `where` and `aggregations[0].filter` (flat and inside a nested `$and` / `$or`) and `having`. "Start past cap" = the remedy's first character at or past 499; "remedy cut" = the remedy is not whole in what the client reads. Before = `origin/main` `4d3a077f`, after = this head.

| Producer arm | n | length before → after | remedy start before → after | start past cap | remedy cut |
|:--|--:|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| temporal: junk (where/filter) | 48 | 392–759 → 392–686 | 319–499 → 143–323 | 1 → 0 | 34 → 1 |
| temporal: junk (having) | 12 | 379–742 → 379–669 | 306–482 → 156–332 | 0 → 0 | 8 → 1 |
| temporal: year range (where/filter) | 36 | 523–703 → 422–638 | 382–600 → 181–328 | 16 → 0 | 36 → 0 |
| temporal: year range (having) | 9 | 511–714 → 410–649 | 370–611 → 194–337 | 3 → 0 | 9 → 0 |
| temporal: misread (where/filter) | 60 | 473–903 → 445–802 | 328–643 → 156–355 | 27 → 0 | 56 → 2 |
| temporal: misread (having) | 15 | 450–913 → 422–812 | 333–653 → 169–364 | 6 → 0 | 12 → 2 |
| temporal: resolved placeholder (where/filter) | 24 | 557–826 → 497–725 | 468–652 → 235–383 | 20 → 0 | 24 → 4 |
| temporal: resolved placeholder (having) | 12 | 536–863 → 476–762 | 463–689 → 262–418 | 9 → 0 | 12 → 3 |
| text-operator door (5 types × 3 operators) | 90 | 694–839 → 693–838 | 502–617 → 152–267 | 90 → 0 | 90 → 0 |
| **all** | 306 | | | **172 → 0** | **281 → 13** |

By name size, remedy cut before → after: 1/1 87 → 0, 12/12 96 → 0, 25/31 98 → 13. The 13 left are all on the 25/31-character names; in each the remedy starts inside the cap and only its tail (the literal-value alternative after a placeholder's own fix, or the last alternative of the `datetime` list behind a 60-character preview) is cut.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/filter-refusal-prescription-cap.test.ts` (new, 31 cases): every refusal arm of both producers, read the way a client reads it, through `mapDataError` (`@objectstack/types`). Each case asserts status 400, code `INVALID_FILTER`, that the opening and closing words of the prescription are in the bounded client text, and that they sit before "NOT applied". Fixtures use a 12-character object and field and paths through an aggregation filter with a nested `$and` / `$or`.
- Ablation, once: both producers restored to the `4d3a077f` blobs (hash-checked on disk), pin run: **31 of 31 failed**; restored to `HEAD` (hash-checked, `git diff HEAD` empty), 31 of 31 pass.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` at `0aa08456`: 479 of 479 files, 8935 tests passed.
- `@objectstack/rest`, the 46 test files that name a temporal or text operator or `INVALID_FILTER` (after building the closure): 46 of 46 files, 1051 passed, 289 skipped (the PostgreSQL-gated legs).
- After merging `origin/main` (`f2afe56d`; the incoming diff touches one objectql test file): the pin, the having/where temporal door, text-operator door and resolved-token suites, 5 files, 132 of 132.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck`: exit 0. `eslint --no-inline-config` on the four touched files: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- Not touched, by the card: the `$null` non-boolean sentence (`rest-4xx-message-truncation.test.ts` pins that truncation on purpose).
- The card's two unlocated producers, measured with this branch's `tsx` against the source: `no-operator-object-door.ts` json and address variants keep the whole remedy inside the cap (remedy start 275–310, end 431–466 for a 15-character field); the single-valued lookup variant on `aggregations[i].filter` / `having` starts its route at 329–336 but its trailing `$in` example ends at 510–517, so the example is cut. Reported to the seat as a finding, not changed here. `having-filter.ts`'s cross-column class refusal carries no prescription sentence to move; left as is.

## Verification

Derived gate families at head `f2afe56d` (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, change set 5 files, 252 changed lines vs `origin/main` `ebfadb02`), each run once and its exit code captured before any pipe. `--ran` reconciliation: **59 derived, 58 run, 1 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun**.

- 58 exit 0.
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET ("Run `pnpm build` first": it needs every published package's `dist`, and only the rest closure was built here). NOT MEASURED locally; CI runs it.
